title: Hearty Indulgent Filipino Pork Bicol Express
description: A nutty and springy Filipino dish featuring pork, chili peppers, and coconut milk, served with keto-friendly corn tortillas and fried rice
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add pork shoulder and cook until browned, about 5 minutes
Add sliced chili peppers, minced garlic, and chopped onion, and cook until the vegetables are tender
Pour in coconut milk and stir to combine, bringing the mixture to a simmer
Reduce heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally
While the sauce is simmering, prepare the cauliflower rice by grating it and frying it in a separate pan with a little coconut oil until crispy
Warm the corn tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds
Assemble the dish by placing a portion of the pork and sauce onto a tortilla, topping with fried cauliflower rice and serving immediately
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
